case_name: Procedure and powers of special Judge
facts: The procedure and powers of a special Judge are being discussed.
A special Judge may take cognizance of offences without the accused being committed to him for trial.
A special Judge may tender a pardon to any person supposed to have been directly or indirectly concerned in, or privy to, an offence.
The provisions of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 shall apply to the proceedings before a special Judge.
A special Judge may pass upon any person convicted by him any sentence authorised by law for the punishment of the offence of which such person is convicted.
